mode.title: What to extract
enumTitles: Sentiment report per game (score, trend, review bombs, languages, playtime, keywords)
Review history over time (monthly + last 30 days)
Reviews written by a Steam user
mode.description: summary: one sentiment report per game. reviews: every review with its text. history: positive/negative counts per month and per day for the last 30 days, with review-bomb flags. languages: score per review language. userReviews: all reviews a Steam user has published.

apps.title: Games
apps.description: Steam app IDs, store/community URLs, or game names (a name is matched to the first Steam search result). Used by summary, reviews, history and languages.

steamUsers.title: Steam users
steamUsers.description: Profile URLs (steamcommunity.com/id/... or /profiles/...), SteamID64s or custom URL names. Used by userReviews. Private profiles return a 'private_profile' row.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per game / user
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Cap for the reviews and userReviews modes. Steam serves 100 reviews per request, so 1,000 reviews = 10 requests.

sortBy.title: Review order
enumTitles: Most helpful (only reviews from the last 1-365 days)
sortBy.description: Newest first is the only order that walks the WHOLE review history. 'Most helpful' is limited by Steam to reviews posted in the last Most-helpful window days.

language.title: Review language
language.description: Only reviews written in this language (reviews mode and the summary's review sample). Text sentiment is computed for English reviews only.

purchaseType.title: Purchase type
enumTitles: Steam purchases only (what the store score counts)
purchaseType.description: Steam's store score counts Steam purchases only; key buyers can add 10-40% more reviews.

startDate.title: Reviews posted from
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. With 'Newest first' the scan stops as soon as it passes this date, so incremental runs are cheap.

minPlaytimeHours.title: Min playtime (hours)
minPlaytimeHours.description: Only reviews whose author had at least this many hours in the game when reviewing.

maxPlaytimeHours.title: Max playtime (hours)
maxPlaytimeHours.description: Only reviews written with at most this many hours played.

helpfulDayRange.title: Most-helpful window (days)
helpfulDayRange.description: Only for 'Most helpful' order. Steam caps it at 365.

includeOffTopicReviews.title: Include off-topic review activity
includeOffTopicReviews.description: Steam hides reviews from periods it flagged as off-topic (review bombs). Turn on to include them.

textSentiment.title: Text sentiment score
textSentiment.description: Adds a VADER sentiment score to each English review and flags reviews whose text contradicts their thumbs up/down.

sampleSize.title: Summary: reviews to analyse
sampleSize.description: Summary mode reads this many newest reviews to compute playtime, Steam Deck, refund and keyword breakdowns. 0 = totals and trend only.

languages.title: Summary / languages: language list
languages.description: Languages to break down. Empty = 11 biggest languages for summary, all 30 for the languages mode.

country.title: Store country
country.description: Two-letter country code for prices and name search.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel games
maxConcurrency.description: How many games/users are processed in parallel. Without a proxy they share one IP and one rate-limit budget, so more parallelism does not speed things up.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: Retries per request on rate limits, server errors or network failures, with exponential backoff.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Steam has no bot wall but rate-limits each IP (~46 review requests/min). A proxy gives every game its own IP and swaps it on a rate limit, so big jobs finish much faster. Without one the actor still works, just paced.
